sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

As the shapes approach, you must strategically position your defenses to block their path and protect your treasure. With each level, the shapes become increasingly difficult to defend against, requiring you to adapt your strategy on the fly. But don't worry, the game starts off slow and gradually increases in difficulty, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.
